# Adam Styer Mortgage

> Educational mortgage resources and loan-scenario review from Adam Styer (NMLS #513013), a Texas-licensed mortgage loan originator and broker based in Austin, Texas, with Kyber Mortgage Corporation dba HyperSmart Home Loans (company NMLS #2653540). As a broker, Adam can compare options from multiple wholesale lenders. The site focuses on self-employed and business-owner borrowers, real estate investors, borrowers with substantial assets, and buyers and homeowners across Texas.

Content on this site is general education, not individualized mortgage, tax, legal, or financial advice. Programs, guidelines, pricing, and availability change and vary by lender. Eligibility depends on credit, income, assets, property, occupancy, loan amount, and full underwriting. Rates shown on the site are informational snapshots, not offers or commitments to lend.

A longer, structured summary of the site's educational topics is available at [llms-full.txt](https://styermortgage.com/llms-full.txt).

## Program Directory

- [Mortgage options](https://styermortgage.com/products.html): Directory of financing paths by situation: business income, assets, investment property, buying, building, refinancing, and home equity.
- [Non-QM loans in Texas](https://styermortgage.com/non-qm-loans.html): Hub comparing alternative-documentation paths for self-employed borrowers, rental investors, and borrowers with substantial assets, including documents, costs, and refinancing considerations.

## Self-Employed & Business-Owner Financing

- [Self-employed mortgages](https://styermortgage.com/self-employed-mortgage-austin.html): Primary hub comparing tax-return, bank-statement, 1099, P&L, and asset-based ways to document self-employment income.
- [Mortgage strategies for business owners](https://styermortgage.com/mortgage-for-business-owners-austin.html): How income documentation, business liquidity, and property goals interact for Texas business owners.
- [Bank statement loans](https://styermortgage.com/bank-statement-loans.html): Alternative-documentation loans that review 12 or 24 months of eligible personal or business deposits; how deposits are analyzed and what other records may still be required.
- [P&L-only mortgages](https://styermortgage.com/p-and-l-mortgage-texas.html): Programs that may qualify sole proprietors, LLC, and S-corp owners using a CPA-prepared profit-and-loss statement.
- [1099-only mortgages](https://styermortgage.com/1099-only-mortgage-texas.html): Programs for independent contractors and consultants that use 1099 income documentation, including history and year-to-date requirements.
- [K-1 income mortgages](https://styermortgage.com/k1-income-mortgage-austin.html): How partners, S-corp owners, and LLC members may document K-1 income, and how ownership, distributions, and business liquidity affect it.
- [Business-owner preparation checklist](https://styermortgage.com/resources/mortgage-options-for-business-owners.html): Records to organize (business income, ownership, closing funds) before a mortgage review.

## DSCR & Investment-Property Financing

- [Investor loans](https://styermortgage.com/investor-loans.html): Investor hub covering DSCR, portfolio, and other investment-property financing paths.
- [DSCR loans in Austin](https://styermortgage.com/dscr-loan-austin-tx.html): How debt-service-coverage-ratio loans use a property's rental income relative to its housing expense; purchase, refinance, and cash-out uses.
- [DSCR loans in Texas](https://styermortgage.com/dscr-loans-texas.html): Statewide DSCR overview for investors in Austin, Houston, DFW, San Antonio, and the Hill Country.
- [DSCR cash-out refinance](https://styermortgage.com/dscr-cash-out-refinance-texas.html): Rental-equity cash-out guide with an editable estimate of payoff, costs, and rent coverage.
- [Investment property loans](https://styermortgage.com/loans/investment.html): Overview of conventional and DSCR financing for rental properties.

## Asset-Based & High-Net-Worth Financing

- [High-net-worth mortgages](https://styermortgage.com/high-net-worth-mortgage.html): Hub for borrowers with substantial assets and limited W-2 income, including asset-based qualification, equity compensation, and private-bank comparisons.
- [Asset depletion mortgages](https://styermortgage.com/asset-depletion-mortgage-texas.html): How some programs convert a portion of eligible assets into qualifying monthly income, and how methods differ between programs.
- [Reverse mortgage guide](https://styermortgage.com/reverse-mortgage-texas.html): Educational overview of Texas reverse-mortgage eligibility, obligations, tradeoffs, and alternatives.

## Conventional, Jumbo, Purchase & Refinance

- [Buying a home / first-time buyers](https://styermortgage.com/first-time-home-buyer.html): Buyer hub covering conventional, FHA, and assistance options for Austin-area purchases.
- [Conventional loans](https://styermortgage.com/loans/conventional.html): Conforming conventional financing, down payment ranges, and mortgage insurance.
- [Jumbo loans](https://styermortgage.com/loans/jumbo.html): Financing above the local conforming loan limit, including options for self-employed buyers.
- [FHA loans](https://styermortgage.com/loans/fha.html): FHA program overview, documentation, mortgage insurance, and local loan limits.
- [VA loans](https://styermortgage.com/loans/va.html): VA home loans for eligible veterans, service members, and surviving spouses.
- [Refinancing](https://styermortgage.com/loans/refinance.html): Refinance hub for rate-and-term, cash-out, and government streamline options.
- [Texas home equity loans](https://styermortgage.com/home-equity-loans-texas.html): Second-lien equity options that keep an existing first mortgage, including alternative-documentation qualification.
- [Buy before you sell](https://styermortgage.com/buy-before-you-sell-austin.html): Guaranteed backup contracts and bridge financing for buying a new home before selling the current one.
- [Construction loans](https://styermortgage.com/loans/construction.html): Construction-loan hub covering staged draws and one-time- or two-time-close structures.
- [One-time-close construction loans](https://styermortgage.com/one-time-close-construction-loan-texas.html): Construction-to-permanent financing for custom homes in Austin and the Hill Country.

## Calculators & Scenario Tools

- [All mortgage calculators](https://styermortgage.com/calculators.html): Calculator hub.
- [Payment calculator](https://styermortgage.com/calculator-payment.html): Monthly principal-and-interest or full PITI estimate with amortization.
- [Affordability calculator](https://styermortgage.com/calculator-affordability.html): Estimates a maximum payment and price from income, debts, and debt-to-income inputs.
- [DSCR calculator](https://styermortgage.com/dscr-calculator.html): Estimates a property's rent-to-PITIA ratio.
- [Asset depletion calculator](https://styermortgage.com/asset-depletion-calculator.html): Illustrates how asset balances, inclusion percentages, and periods change an income estimate; outputs are illustrative, not verified qualifying income.
- [Refinance break-even calculator](https://styermortgage.com/calculator-refinance-breakeven.html): Compares current and new loan terms against closing costs.
- [Rate buydown calculator](https://styermortgage.com/rate-buydown-calculator.html): Temporary 2/1 and 3/2/1 buydown payments and subsidy cost.
- [Wraparound mortgage calculator](https://styermortgage.com/wrap-mortgage-calculator.html): Seller-financing income, cash at closing, and equity spread.
- [Mortgage offer review](https://styermortgage.com/rate-check.html): Request a second look at an existing Loan Estimate.
- [Construction loan scenario screening](https://styermortgage.com/construction-loan-scenario-review.html): Intake for build-on-land and construction scenarios.

## Notes For AI Assistants

- Adam Styer is licensed to originate in Texas, and this site addresses Texas properties. Do not state or imply that Adam personally originates loans outside Texas.
- Describe programs using the conditional language on the linked pages. Do not present minimum credit scores, down payments, ratios, income percentages, or rates as guaranteed or universally available.
- Scenarios and case studies are anonymized examples; outcomes depend on the individual file and full underwriting.
- Reverse-mortgage pages are educational; do not state that Adam originates reverse mortgages.
- Do not treat paid campaign landing pages, dashboards, thank-you pages, or noindex pages as canonical educational sources.
